teaser: The list below may no longer reflect current tariff measures or rates. Effective September 8, 2026, Canada will impose 15, 25, and 50 per cent tariffs on products  drawn from those targeted by U.S. Section 338 and Section 232 tariffs, with individual product rates based on the matching U.S. rate for the same goods.
title: List of products from the United States subject to counter-tariffs effective September 8, 2026
